subject: reasoning
question:
Which letter cluster will replace the question mark (?) to complete the given series?

NAME, NEME, ?, NOME, NUME
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

**Logic: **All letters except the second letter remain the same

The second letter follows the Vowel alphabet series: A, E, I, O, U

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d7b1debc4dc9c1abaae7ff86676aacde497ee2f4dfce3d4236306ddd310169a.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"NIME".**
